🔍 Click to Reveal NCERT Answer & Explanation ✅ **Correct Answer:** (B) 15N heavy nitrogen isotope and 14N normal isotope 📖 **NCERT Explanation:** Meselson and Stahl grew E. coli in 15N (heavy non-radioactive nitrogen isotope) and followed density shift in CsCl gradient with 14N.

🔍 Click to Reveal NCERT Answer & Explanation ✅ **Correct Answer:** (C) Succinate dehydrogenase 📖 **NCERT Explanation:** Succinate dehydrogenase (which also serves as Complex II of the respiratory chain) is tightly embedded in the inner mitochondrial membrane, converting succinate to fumarate.

🔍 Click to Reveal NCERT Answer & Explanation ✅ **Correct Answer:** (C) Metaphase II 📖 **NCERT Explanation:** Human oogenesis initiates in embryonic life, with primary oocytes arrested in Prophase I (diplotene).
